changes: NOTHING WAS CHANGED. This is not a transcription: the manufacturer serves this model as a text file, so it was frozen byte-for-byte under vendor/ and the whole file - model text and the vendor's own comment blocks - was appended below a header of our own. No parameter was removed (unlike models/jfet/lsk489.lib and models/bjt_pnp/ls350.lib, where mfg= had to be stripped because ngspice evaluates it as an expression and dies; this file has no mfg=), no value was rounded, reordered or 'corrected', and the model NAME was left exactly as served. Verifiable rather than asserted: diff <(grep -v '^\*' <vendor file>) <(grep -v '^\*' <this file>) is empty. One consequence worth knowing: the vendor file uses CRLF and our header uses LF, so the assembled file has MIXED line endings. That is deliberate - normalising the whole file rewrites the vendor bytes and breaks the diff above, silently. It happened once during L25 and only the diff caught it.

notes: hFE CLEAN, fT NOT. Datasheet MJE15032/D, December 2024 Rev. 7 (the two devices share one document, which is why this part's vendor directory holds no PDF of its own). ngspice 47, set temp = 25: hFE 88.218 / 66.917 / 42.766 at IC = 0.5 / 1.0 / 2.0 A, VCE = -5 V against minima of 70 / 50 / 10 - all INSIDE, and where the NPN misses its 70 minimum by 5.1% this one clears it by 26%. fT at IC = 500 mA, VCE = -10 V, ftest = 1.0 MHz is 29.286 MHz against a 30 MHz MINIMUM: 2.4% short, recorded as NC-025 together with the NPN and NEW IN L25. L24 recorded 31.38 MHz and read it as inside; the difference is the datasheet's own definition of fT (Note 2, 'fT = hfe ftest', ftest = 1.0 MHz) rather than the |hfe| = 1 crossing, which gives 30.719 MHz. Direction pessimistic - the model is slower than the guaranteed part. Bias verified: op prints IC = -5.00000e-01. A GAP THAT BELONGS TO THE PART, NOT THE MODEL, DECLARED AND NOT FILLED: onsemi has no product page for MJE15033G, so its T8 lifecycle evidence is the ordering table of the datasheet ('orderable'), not an explicit Active string as for its NPN complement. ADR-017 lists this among the conditions that reopen the decision. Same contractor authorship as the NPN: MODPEX / Symmetry Design Systems, 1 February 2004, PSpice format. NO KF/AF, therefore NO 1/f noise - in this repo only models/jfet/lsk489.lib has flicker noise, which is why NC-004 does not close when the real models arrive. Any noise figure computed with this device is a floor without flicker and must say so next to the number.
